v: An a priori power analysis in G*Power showed that 50 participants per group give 80% power (alpha = .05) for d = 0.5 in an unpaired t-test.
A sensitivity power analysis indicated that 40 participants give 90% power for d = 0.8 with pwr.
The observed power was 0.45 for the effect in 36 participants (post-hoc).
